title: Memory Manager Dwell Table
description: Define runtime configuration parameters. The following
EDS configuration impact this table:
MEM_MGR_DWELL_NAME_LEN: Number of characters in a dwell name
MEM_MGR_DWELL_ID_CNT: Number of dwell tables/telemetry messages
MEM_MGR_DWELL_ENTRIES: Number of entries per dwell table
Every entry must be defined in the default table. During runtime
after the default table has been loaded, partial entry lists can
be supplied, however every table must be present.
Valid non-null entry requirements:
- mem-size:
- Must be 1, 2, or 4 which correspond to mem_mgr.xml's
MEM_MGR_MemSize_Enum_t
- delay:
- Delay (execution cycles) before next dwell entry is sampled.
The sum of delays determines the telemetry message's output
rate. A common pattern is all zeroes with the last entry having
a non-zero delay. A delay sum of zero doesn't execute.
- address:
- If symbol is an empty string then offseet is the address
- Sum of symbol+offset must be a valid acessible address
- If mem-size is 2 then address must be even
- If mem-size is 4 then address must be evenly divisible by 4
